comments.react-native-worklets: Hoisted to the root on purpose: Metro resolves it from apps/mobile while the reanimated Babel plugin resolves it from the root. If it is only a workspace dep, npm nests it under apps/mobile and the two disagree (or the plugin fails to resolve it at all). Keep this and the override on the same version.
comments.react: Pinned so the whole workspace resolves ONE copy. Every peer range here is satisfied by ^19.0.0, but the lockfile had drifted to a nested react@19.2.4 under apps/cms alongside the hoisted 19.2.3. npm flags that `invalid` and will not repair it on install. Two React copies make Next's RSC pass fail with `Could not find the module ... in the React Client Manifest` on every page. Keep in step with apps/mobile, whose Expo SDK pins 19.2.3.
